Cross-validate the point classifier: spatial blocks vs random folds

Source: R/classify.R
cv_point_classifier.Rd

Every held-out non-vegetation point is scored; vegetation is scored on a random eval_veg_frac sample and up-weighted by its inverse, so precision is estimated at the site's real class prevalence. Two threshold-free summaries are added: per-class average precision (area under the precision-recall curve; compare it with prevalence, its no-skill value) and balanced accuracy (mean per-class recall of the argmax decision).

Usage

cv_point_classifier(
  feat,
  n_per_class = 20000,
  num_trees = 200,
  mtry = NULL,
  drop_features = NULL,
  eval_veg_frac = 0.1,
  random = TRUE,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

feat

Labelled features with fold (from assign_blocks()).

n_per_class

Maximum training points per class.

num_trees, mtry

Passed to ranger::ranger().

drop_features

Feature columns to exclude (for ablation).

eval_veg_frac

Fraction of held-out vegetation points scored.

random

Also run random k-fold CV for comparison.

seed

RNG seed.

Value

A list with metrics (per-class precision / recall / F1 and balanced accuracy for each scheme), confusion (spatial-CV confusion matrix in estimated point counts, rows = weak label, columns = prediction) and fold_counts (labelled points per spatial fold).
